tie_breakers_considered: density: 23 relations over 17 components (E > N) also fits a mesh/fabric, but there is no spine/leaf tier set and no redundant-link pair; the single double-direction pair (machines <-> boot server) is a request/response, not redundancy
placement-planes: rejected - there is no bus between weakly-connected worlds; every component reaches the others through the River queue
identity-probe-maps: rejected - the source is role/protocol dense, not address/qualifier dense (no IPs, ports, ASNs or uncertainty markers)
motion: the human asked for slow dots and then for one dot per line, so motion is the signature, not a tie-breaker
